hera.definition: n. queen of the Olympian gods in ancient Greek mythology; sister and wife of Zeus remembered for her jealously of the many mortal women Zeus fell in love with; identified with Roman Juno

heracles.definition: n (classical mythology) a hero noted for his strength; performed 12 immense labors to gain immortality
heracles.translation: n. 大力英雄, 力士, 武仙座

heraclid.translation: n. 自称为大力神赫拉克勒斯后裔的人

heraclitean.translation:
a. (古希腊哲学家)赫拉克利特(哲学)的
n. 赫拉克利特(哲学)的追随者[亦作 Heraclitic]

heraclitus.definition: n a presocratic Greek philosopher who said that fire is the origin of all things and that permanence is an illusion as all things are in perpetual flux (circa 500 BC)
heraclitus.translation: 赫拉克利特(纪元前五世纪的希腊哲学家)

heraclius.translation: n. 赫拉克利乌斯（东罗马帝国皇帝）

herakles.definition: n (classical mythology) a hero noted for his strength; performed 12 immense labors to gain immortality
herakles.translation: n. 大力英雄, 力士, 武仙座

heraklid.translation: n. 自称为大力神赫拉克勒斯后裔的人

herald.definition: n. (formal) a person who announces important news
herald.translation:
n. 使者, 传令官, 先驱
vt. 预报, 宣布, 传达, 欢呼

heralded.translation: v. 预示( herald的过去式和过去分词 ); 宣布（好或重要）

heraldic.definition:
s. indicative of or announcing something to come
a. of or relating to heraldry
heraldic.translation: a. 纹章学的, 纹章的, 传令官的

heraldically.definition:
adv. In an heraldic manner; according to the rules of
   heraldry.

heralding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Herald
heralding.translation: v. 预示( herald的现在分词 ); 宣布（好或重要）

heraldist.definition: a of or relating to heraldry

heraldries.translation: 纹章, 纹章学( heraldry的名词复数 )

heraldry.definition:
n. the study and classification of armorial bearings and the tracing of genealogies
n. emblem indicating the right of a person to bear arms
heraldry.translation: n. 纹章学, 纹章, 家徽

heralds.definition:
n (formal) a person who announces important news
n something that precedes and indicates the approach of something or someone
v foreshadow or presage
v praise vociferously
v greet enthusiastically or joyfully
heralds.translation:
n. 使者( herald的名词复数 ); 预报者; 预兆; 传令官
v. 预示( herald的第三人称单数 ); 宣布（好或重要）

herapathite.definition:
n. The sulphate of iodoquinine, a substance crystallizing
   in thin plates remarkable for their effects in polarizing light.

herat.definition: n. a city in northwestern Afghanistan on the site of several ancient cities
herat.translation: n. 赫拉特（阿富汗西北部城市）
